ExternalDrivers.method: Observed measurements and planned or forecast assumptions remain distinct. Availability is the source-declared calendar date compared with the selected cutoff, not verified historical knowledge or a learned causal effect. Replenishment.title: Replenishment drafts
Replenishment.description: Inspect the stock-and-inbound position against a saved policy maximum. These drafts show an unrounded gap; supplier constraints, arrival scheduling and order execution follow separately.
Replenishment.choosePolicy: Choose a policy maximum to start a draft
Replenishment.changeBasis: Choose a different maximum in the policy workbench
Replenishment.backordersNote: Enter the quantity in the saved policy unit, including zero if none. Exclude commitments already included in stock allocations to avoid counting them twice.
Replenishment.confirmation: I confirm that all remaining inbound orders for this item and location are recorded and synchronized with the stock position at {date}.
Replenishment.asOfNote: Open orders are a mutable feed. This confirmation describes the recorded scenario; ZeeSpare cannot reconstruct a historical order book or verify completeness from missing rows.
Replenishment.invalid: Enter a nonnegative backorder quantity with at most 15 integer and three fractional digits.
Replenishment.formula: Gap = max(maximum − (on-hand − allocations + remaining open inbound − additional unallocated backorders), 0).
Replenishment.confirmed: Order completeness and synchronization confirmed for this scenario.
Replenishment.unconfirmed: Order completeness and synchronization have not been confirmed.
Replenishment.timingNote: All positive open inbound is included, even when overdue or expected after the protection period ending {date}. Timing flags do not change the quantity; a zero gap does not establish that arrivals will prevent a stock-out. Receipts are not subtracted again.
Replenishment.truncated: More than 1,000 positive open lines exist. No partial inbound total or gap is calculated; line evidence is omitted.
Replenishment.noOrders: No positive open inbound lines are recorded. Only the explicit completeness confirmation permits treating this as zero inbound.
Replenishment.saveNote: Save the displayed inputs and result, including any unavailable diagnosis. Later feed edits do not change this record.
Replenishment.changed: The inputs or request changed. Refresh the preview and review it before saving again.
Replenishment.immutable: This record retains the evidence captured when it was saved. It does not place or reserve an order.

Classification.title: Classify demand
Classification.description: Classify daily sold demand and compare value within each currency.
Classification.scope: Includes all catalog items at one location. Recorded introduction and discontinuation dates limit each item’s observation window. If sales history is incomplete, use Check demand data first.
Classification.thresholdNote: Shares use fractions (0.8 = 80%). ADI must be at least 1; ABC shares must increase and stay below 1; XYZ boundaries must increase. Equal-value items remain together in ABC.
Classification.confirmation: I confirm that this location and date window contain complete sales history. Missing days within each item’s lifecycle may be treated as zero sold demand.
Classification.confirmationRequired: Confirm complete sales history before classifying demand.
Classification.methodNote: Daily method v1. Missing days are zero only under the planner’s complete-history confirmation. Lost sales are separate. ABC uses captured current costs, separately per currency. Lifecycle evidence does not infer obsolescence.

Forecasting.title: Create forecast
Forecasting.description: Compare seven daily sold-demand baselines using three rolling backtests. Review the selected model and expected daily quantities.
Forecasting.limits: Select up to 10 items for automatic models, or 100 for baselines. History is limited to 1,096 days; horizons are 1–90 days. Automatic runs may take several minutes.
Forecasting.confirmation: I confirm complete sales history for these items at this location and date window. Missing days within each item’s recorded lifecycle may be treated as zero sold demand.
Forecasting.confirmationRequired: Confirm complete sales history before forecasting.
Forecasting.method: baseline-v1 · Daily sold demand; lost sales excluded. Missing observed days are zero after confirmation. Fixed smoothing coefficients: 0.1. Three rolling test windows; lowest pooled RMSE selects the model. Forecasts stop after a recorded discontinuation date.
Forecasting.insufficientNote: Selection needs 56 training days plus three complete test windows. Items whose recorded lifecycle has ended are not extrapolated.
Forecasting.scoreNote: Scores pool daily forecast errors across the same three withheld windows. Signed bias is forecast minus actual: positive means over-forecasting. Scores use unrounded predictions; displayed forecasts use three decimals. Equal scores follow the listed model order. These are selection scores, not an independent estimate of future accuracy.
Forecasting.sourceNote: Stored observations within the lifecycle-clipped window are shown below. Unlisted observed days count as zero; lost sales are retained as evidence but excluded from the models.

statuses.incompatible_units: Conflicting demand units — normalize the supplied history units and run a new forecast.

Forecasting.expandedChoice: Automatic models and uncertainty (up to 10 items)
Forecasting.expandedMethod: expanded-v1: seven baselines plus bounded automatic ETS/ARIMA, selected by three rolling RMSE backtests. Automatic models use floating-point fitting; negative predictions are clipped to zero.
Forecasting.unavailableModels: These automatic candidates could not complete fitting and were excluded: {models}.
Forecasting.uncertaintyNote: 80% and 95% empirical bands use 2,000 seeded bootstrap draws from pooled out-of-sample errors. They assume errors are exchangeable across days and forecast horizons. They may understate uncertainty for sparse demand, changing patterns or dependent errors; all-zero history cannot reveal unseen demand. These are marginal daily bands, not a horizon-total interval or a service-level guarantee.
Forecasting.calibrationCount: Calibration errors: {count}. At least 20 are required.

uncertaintyStatuses.insufficient_residuals: Too few calibration errors for uncertainty bands.

Forecasting.coverageNote: A separate historical exercise selects a model and constructs bands before the final withheld window. Coverage is the fraction of withheld daily observations inside the bands. It evaluates the forecasting procedure at that earlier cutoff; the final selected model can differ. This single window is a diagnostic, not a calibration guarantee.
Forecasting.coverageWindow: {model}; trained through {train}. Held-out window: {from} – {to} ({count} days), using {calibration} earlier calibration errors.

evaluationStatuses.insufficient_history: Coverage needs 56 training days plus four horizon-length windows.
evaluationStatuses.insufficient_residuals: Coverage needs at least 20 earlier calibration errors.

Preparation.title: Prepare demand
Preparation.description: Inspect related-part demand and calendar evidence before using it in future planning models.
Preparation.limits: Select up to 25 codes at one location. All connected predecessors, successors and two-way interchanges are included, up to 100 source items and 1,096 history days. Larger groups must be reviewed separately.
Preparation.rules: preparation-v1 uses relationships effective at the history cutoff to convert all predecessor history into terminal-successor units. Same-unit two-way interchanges are pooled at 1:1; one-way substitutes stay separate. Each source is counted once. Conflicting paths block aggregation. This run does not alter sales records or forecasts.
Preparation.confirmation: I confirm complete sales history for the selected location and window, including every related source item. Missing days within each item’s recorded lifecycle may be treated as zero.
Preparation.confirmationRequired: Confirm complete history for all related source items before preparing demand.
Preparation.contributionNote: Original totals are clipped to each source’s lifecycle. Conversion factors multiply along effective replacement paths. Displayed totals use three decimal places; stored calculations retain exact decimal values.
Preparation.calendarNote: Calendar flags use captured reference data and organization overrides. Unverified holiday and Ramadan/Eid dates are unknown. Closures never erase recorded sales. No regional uplift or synthetic heat multiplier is applied.
Preparation.lifecycleNote: A dash means no source lifecycle covers that date. Zero is used only inside confirmed source lifecycles. Working-day status follows calendar override, country override, applicable holiday, then weekend rules.

issues.conflicting_conversion: Replacement paths disagree on the terminal part or conversion factor.
issues.relationship_cycle: The combined relationship graph contains a cycle.

PreparedForecast.title: Forecast this prepared group
PreparedForecast.description: Compare ten candidates using the saved combined sold demand and units. This includes a bounded weekday, holiday and Ramadan model. Lost sales remain separate.
PreparedForecast.confirmation: I understand that these comparisons hold the saved group and unit conversions fixed across all windows. They do not reconstruct historical planning decisions.
PreparedForecast.confirmationRequired: Confirm the fixed-group comparison before queuing the forecast.
PreparedForecast.method: Prepared-group forecast · regional-v1. Ten candidates compete on lowest RMSE across three rolling windows. A separate held-out window checks empirical daily band coverage when enough history exists.
PreparedForecast.comparisonNote: Fixed-group comparisons: the saved relationships, conversions and calendar assumptions apply across every window. Scores and coverage compare models for that saved group; they do not reconstruct historical planning decisions. Demand fitting uses only each training window.
PreparedForecast.units: Quantities and adjustments use the saved group unit: {unit}.
PreparedForecast.window: Saved window starts {from}. Training uses the contiguous eligible history from {used} through {to}. Days with no eligible source are excluded; forecasts are zero when every saved member is outside its lifecycle. Partial membership changes are not scaled.
PreparedForecast.preparationLink: Inspect saved preparation and source contributions
PreparedForecast.sourceNote: Combined sold demand in saved group units is the model input. Lost sales are reported separately. Eligible missing days were set to zero under the preparation’s confirmed-history assumption. Live demand and relationship edits do not change this saved run.
PreparedForecast.effectsNote: Weekday means use training demand. Verified holiday and Ramadan residual differences are shrunk toward zero using 14 support days and bounded by the largest training quantity. An effect needs at least two event days and 28 ordinary days. Holiday takes precedence over Ramadan. Support counts are days, not repeated annual events; this is not a causal estimate.
PreparedForecast.candidateSelected: The calendar candidate was selected; these effects are used where the future event is verified.
PreparedForecast.candidateNotSelected: Another model was selected. These calendar candidate effects are shown for inspection and are not applied to the selected forecast.
PreparedForecast.unknownCounts: Unknown event dates: {history} in training and {future} in the forecast horizon. Unknown dates receive no event adjustment.
PreparedForecast.futureNote: Future reference dates and overrides were captured at the first processing attempt. Dates outside verified coverage remain unknown. Working-day flags are evidence only and do not force demand to zero.

InventoryPolicy.title: Inventory policy recommendation
InventoryPolicy.formNote: Use this saved forecast to estimate stock targets. Lead time plus review interval must fit within its {horizon}-day horizon. Lead times are fixed calendar days; the service target is cycle service, not fill rate.
InventoryPolicy.asOf: Planning date: {date}. This recommendation starts after the saved forecast cutoff.
InventoryPolicy.inputs: Lead time: {lead} days · Review interval: {review} days · Cycle-service target: {service}%
InventoryPolicy.assumptions: Conditional estimate from sold-demand forecasts and independently sampled historical forecast errors. Sparse demand, serial dependence, changing demand and unseen demand can invalidate this estimate. Lost sales and variable supply lead times are not modeled. The target is not a guarantee of achieved service.
InventoryPolicy.groupNote: Values use the saved group and its unit conversions. Comparisons are conditional on that fixed group; they do not reconstruct historical planning decisions or allocate stock among member parts.

statuses.insufficient_residuals: Insufficient calibration errors: at least 20 are required.

InventoryPolicy.rulesNote: The reorder-point reference covers lead time. The periodic order-up-to maximum covers lead time plus the review interval. These describe different review rules, not an optimized hybrid min/max policy. They are recommendations, before stock/order netting, sourcing and pack-size rounding.

InventoryPolicy.calibrationNote: Each fit uses only demand through its training cutoff. The chosen model is held fixed and was selected using these comparison windows, so these errors can be optimistic; this is not an independent policy coverage test.

MOQ, packs, calendars and supply variability are excluded.

DriverForecast.title: Create driver forecast
DriverForecast.noMatches: No matching individual forecasts with known demand units. Create a baseline or expanded forecast for the same item, location, history window and horizon first.
DriverForecast.confirmation: I confirm this captured demand and driver dataset apply together. Availability dates are source claims; planned values remain assumptions. Reuse the saved history, units and windows without refreshing demand.
DriverForecast.confirmationRequired: Confirm applicability and reuse of the captured evidence.
DriverForecast.incompatible: Choose a successful individual forecast with known units and exactly matching item, location, history and forecast windows.
DriverForecast.method: driver-v1 compares the nine existing models with one fixed regularized linear driver/weekday model using the same three rolling RMSE windows. Each fit and its scaling use only that training prefix. Negative predictions are clipped to zero. Missing or late driver values exclude that candidate; existing models can still be selected.
DriverForecast.uncertainty: 80% and 95% bands use reproducible pooled residual bootstrapping. They are conditional on supplied driver values and exclude uncertainty in those values. Coverage is checked on a separate held-out window when sufficient history exists. No causal effect or guaranteed service level is established.
DriverForecast.availabilityNote: Each check uses its own cutoff, including future predictor values. Source-declared availability is unverified and is separate from server import time. These are conditional comparisons, not a reconstruction of what the system knew historically.
DriverForecast.selectionChecks: Driver checks for model selection and final fit
DriverForecast.driver_late: Driver value declared after this cutoff
DriverForecast.driver_constant: No driver variation beyond weekday effects
DriverForecast.formula: Forecast = weekday intercept + slope × supplied driver value, clipped at zero. Intercepts below run Monday through Sunday. The fixed penalty applies to the slope after training-only centering and scaling; coefficients describe association, not causation.
DriverForecast.extrapolation: Driver values outside the training range occur on:
DriverForecast.conditionalNote: Source availability is unverified. Comparisons are conditional on supplied driver values; uncertainty bands exclude uncertainty in those values.

MultiDriverForecast.confirmationRequired: Confirm that all selected datasets represent distinct applicable drivers.

MultiDriverForecast.method: multi-driver-v1 compares nine existing models with one joint driver/weekday model using three rolling RMSE windows. All selected drivers must pass availability checks for each training and prediction window. Scaling uses that training prefix only; fixed ridge regularization retains correlated drivers. Missing, late or constant inputs exclude the entire joint candidate, without filling or dropping a driver. Negative predictions are clipped to zero.
MultiDriverForecast.uncertainty: 80% and 95% bands use reproducible pooled residual bootstrapping. They are conditional on supplied driver values and exclude uncertainty in those values. Coverage is checked on a separate held-out window when sufficient history exists. No causal effect or guaranteed service level is established.
MultiDriverForecast.availabilityNote: Each check uses its own cutoff, including future predictor values. Source-declared availability is unverified and is separate from server import time. These are conditional comparisons, not a reconstruction of what the system knew historically.
MultiDriverForecast.selectionChecks: Driver checks for model selection and final fit
MultiDriverForecast.driver_late: Driver value declared after this cutoff
MultiDriverForecast.driver_constant: No driver variation beyond weekday effects
MultiDriverForecast.formula: Prediction = the weekday intercept + the sum of each slope × its supplied driver value, clipped at zero. Coefficients use original driver units; centered, scaled predictors were fitted jointly with fixed regularization. Weekday intercepts below run Monday to Sunday.
MultiDriverForecast.extrapolation: Driver values outside the training range occur on:
MultiDriverForecast.conditionalNote: Scores and coefficients are conditional on all supplied drivers and source availability claims. They are predictive evidence, not causal effects.

InstalledBaseDemand.title: Installed-base demand
InstalledBaseDemand.description: Conditional replacement demand from saved equipment populations and explicit group rates.
InstalledBaseDemand.method: For each group, daily expected demand equals its saved installed quantity multiplied by its explicit replacement rate per installed unit per calendar day. InstalledBaseDemand.limits: This is a conditional scenario using constant populations and rates. It does not fit failure or age models, infer population growth or retirement, calculate uncertainty bands, or change forecasts, policies, stock or orders.
InstalledBaseDemand.rateHelp: Rates are replacements per installed unit per calendar day. Enter a rate, its source or reason, and its declared availability date for every group. Enter zero explicitly when intended; blank rates are unknown. Rates allow up to six integer and nine decimal digits.

InstalledBaseDemand.conditional: Expected part demand in the saved unit, conditional on the supplied population and replacement assumptions. No uncertainty bands are calculated.
InstalledBaseDemand.claims: Declared availability dates are source claims, separate from server recording times. Ages refer to the population as-of date; missing installation dates remain unknown.
InstalledBaseDemand.csvContract: UTF-8 CSV, maximum 512 KiB. Exact columns: group_code, daily_rate, source, available_on. Include every saved group once. Rates allow six integer and nine decimal digits; source/reason allows 1,000 characters. Blank rates are not zero. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Template group codes include a spreadsheet text marker (apostrophe); the importer accepts the complete marked or original group set.

RegionalSourcing.title: Regional sourcing
RegionalSourcing.description: Cover one location’s saved gap with policy-protected stock across a named region.
RegionalSourcing.method: Source surplus is stock after allocations, additional unallocated backorders and the selected maximum. Source inbound is excluded. Allocate the smaller of the destination gap and total usable surplus proportionally, in integer thousandths. Largest remainders receive the remaining thousandths; location identity breaks ties. Smaller fractions remain unallocated.
RegionalSourcing.limits: Saved destination commitments remain fixed. All region members are required, including zero-surplus sources. Scenarios may overlap and reserve no stock. Dates, freight, dealer sharing and transfer execution are not included.
